option.description: Advanced override. When non-empty, this ECharts option replaces the generated chart and the domain props are ignored.

flows.description: One row per flow: { source, target, value }. Nodes are created from the names used here. Rows with the same source and target are summed; rows whose value is not a positive number are skipped. A Sankey diagram cannot show loops: flows that close a loop (and flows from a node to itself) are left out and counted in a note under the title.

nodes.description: Optional per-node overrides: { name, color, label }. name must match a name used in flows; color sets the node colour, label the text shown instead of the name. Nodes without an entry use the theme palette and their own name.

title.description: Chart title. Leave blank for no title.

unit.description: Unit written after every value, e.g. kWh, t, pcs.

decimals.description: Decimal places of the values in labels and tooltips (0 to 6).

orientation.description: Direction of flow: horizontal (left to right) or vertical (top to bottom).

nodeAlign.description: Column placement of nodes: justify puts end nodes in the last column, left packs nodes towards the start, right towards the end.

showValues.description: Write each node's throughput next to its name. Turn off for small components.

linkColor.description: Colour of the links: that of the source node, of the target node, or a gradient from one to the other.

emphasis.description: What is highlighted on hover: adjacency (the node or link and its direct neighbours), trajectory (everything up- and downstream), or none.

nodeWidth.description: Thickness of the node bars in pixels.

nodeGap.description: Gap between neighbouring nodes of a column in pixels.

maxLabelLength.description: Node names longer than this many characters are shortened with an ellipsis in labels (tooltips show the full name). 0 = never shorten.

colors.description: Node colour palette, used in order of first appearance. Leave empty to use the palette of the theme. Colours set in nodes take precedence.

theme.description: Name of a registered ECharts theme. Built-in themes: IgnitionIndustrialDark, IgnitionIndustrialLight. Leave empty for the ECharts default theme.

renderer.description: Rendering engine: canvas (better perf) or svg (better quality/export).

autoResize.description: Automatically resize chart when container dimensions change.

resizeDebounceMs.description: Debounce interval in milliseconds for resize events.

notMerge.description: If true, setOption will not merge with previous option but replace entirely.

lazyUpdate.description: If true, chart update is deferred for better performance during rapid changes.

showLoading.description: Show the built-in ECharts loading animation.

loadingOptions.description: Options for the loading animation (text, color, etc.).

sanitizeTooltip.description: Sanitises HTML in tooltip formatters and blocks non-http(s) links.

ariaLabel.description: Accessible label announced by screen readers.

maps.description: Map definitions for map and geo series, keyed by map name. Each value is a GeoJSON FeatureCollection, or an object with an `svg` string. Set series.map (or geo.map) to the key.
